title: Wrap an index into a ring
description: A ring has n slots numbered 0 to n-1. Walking past the last slot continues at slot 0, and walking backwards from slot 0 arrives at slot n-1. Return the slot of position i, for any integer i, possibly negative: 7 on a ring of 5 gives 2, -1 on a ring of 5 gives 4. The result is always between 0 and n-1. n is positive.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states Euclidean-style non-negative remainder in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
